correctness.rationale: All realizations reduce by pair counting and Bézout to a four-cycle of chords on a smooth conic. The \(\operatorname{PGL}_2\) action yields the stated normal form. Exact symbolic expansion verifies a quadratic Jacobian syzygy, while a \(9\times9\) linear-syzygy coefficient minor is \(108\lambda^2\), so \(\operatorname{mdr}=2\) for every admissible parameter. The simple singularities give \(\tau=18\), and the published near-freeness criterion then yields exponents \((2,4)\).
